newsitem.title: USA: Equitable considers western reserves sale.
newsitem.headline: Equitable considers western reserves sale.

text.p: Equitable Resources Inc said Tuesday it is considering the sale of its oil and natural gas properties in the western United States and Canada.

The company said the properties, held by its Equitable Resources Energy Co subsidiary, are located principally in the Uinta Basin of Utah, the Green River, Powder River and Wind River Basins of Wyoming, the Williston Basin of Montana and North Dakota, and Western Alberta.
Equitable said the properties had estimated proved developed producing reserves of 89 billion cubic feet of natural gas and 13.1 million barrels of oil at December 31.
The company said more than 90 percent of the proved reserves reside in 20 properties, and that it operates more than 70 percent of the reserves.
The company said it has retained the financial advisory firm of Batchelder & Partners Inc to represent them in the proposed sale.
The sale would allow the company to refocus its exploration and development efforts in the Appalachian and Gulf of Mexico areas, it explained.
